newsitem.title: CHINA: China bourse to freeze short-selling funds.
newsitem.headline: China bourse to freeze short-selling funds.

text.p: China's Shenzhen Stock Exchange will from Thursday freeze funds obtained from short-selling to try to curb financial risk, the Securities Daily said.
After the end of clearing, the exchange would from the following day freeze money obtained from short sales of local currency A shares, bonds and funds, the newspaper said.
The funds would be frozen until members buy back equities to cover their short positions, it said, quoting a notice issued by the exchange.
The level of interest paid on the frozen capital would be the same as the interest paid on capital on cleared positions, it said.
The stock exchange would inform members of the amount of funds frozen due to short-selling, the newspaper said.
The notice urged exchange members to strengthen internal management and strictly ban short-selling, it said.
